description: Part of op-g864 (item 1). crates/kovan/src/app/mod.rs's graph-digitiser panel (~line 1294-1318, labeled 'op-96am') and table_digitiser.rs's equivalent still ask for a manual project_root + project_markdown_rel text field before 'Save CSV into project markdown' will work, even when a Kovan root is already open and a paper is active. pdf_reader.rs's save_annotations (op-q1qj) already fixed the equivalent problem for annotations: when active_paper is Some, append straight into the paper's own canonical Markdown via PaperSession::append_block/save_document, falling back to the manual project_root/project_markdown_rel path only when no paper is active (a crop opened outside any paper). Mirror that exact pattern here for both the graph and table digitiser's project-markdown save.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented in both crates/kovan/src/app/mod.rs (graph digitiser, DigitiseApp::save_into_project) and crates/kovan/src/app/table_digitiser.rs (TableDigitiserState::save_into_project, given a new active_paper: Option<&mut PaperSession> parameter threaded through ui() from the View::TableDigitiser call site in mod.rs, mirroring pdf_reader.rs's existing PdfReaderState::ui(..., active_paper) pattern). Both now append the CSV block straight into the active paper's session via PaperSession::append_block/save_document when one is active, falling back to the manual project_root/project_markdown_rel fields + project::append_to_section only when no paper is active. Both UI sections now show 'saving into <citekey>'s notes' instead of the manual fields whenever a paper is active. 4 new tests (2 per digitiser: writes-into-active-session, falls-back-with-no-active-paper). Verified: cargo check -p kovan --all-targets --all-features clean; cargo test -p kovan --lib --release: 383 passed (was 379), 0 failed.

title: Digitiser: wire 'Save into project markdown' to the active paper, not manual project_root fields

description: src/time_stepping/ ports ONLY RKF45 -- an EXPLICIT adaptive method that will step down to Lambda on a stiff problem and stall (eigenvalue spread ~1e6 thermal, ~1e9 fast) -- and NO test exercises the RKF45 path, so its stiff behaviour is unobserved. Rosenbrock12.C, Rosenbrock34.C, rodas23.C and rodas34.C are ALREADY VENDORED in src/time_stepping/openfoam_source_files/ and none is ported. Cheapest robustness win in the scoping document: the reference implementation is already on disk. Add a stiff-problem test at the same time.
title: teh-o-prke: port one Rosenbrock stiff integrator from the vendored OpenFOAM source
